name: Ankle Circles
description: Slow ankle circles to wake up tired feet.

steps.title: Lift one foot
steps.text: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.

steps.title: Trace a circle
steps.text: Draw slow, smooth circles with your toes, five in each direction.

steps.title: Switch feet
steps.text: Rest that foot and repeat with the other.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Press both feet gently into the floor and notice how they feel. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
